description: Amplifyr gives ChatGPT direct access to your brand's AI visibility analytics. Ask in plain English and get instant answers on share of voice, industry rankings, KPIs, citations, sentiment, and the questions people are asking about brands like yours across AI models. Data is scoped to your organisation only. No SQL. No dashboards. Just ask.

defaultPrompt: Show me the KPI summary for my brand for the last 60 days.
